note: Project-kickoff lesson scoping the student's own RAG knowledge assistant build (what's in/out of scope, stack, deliverables, repo layout). No single product UI represents a scoping/planning lesson, and there is no fictional company — the student scaffolds their own repository over their own chosen document set. Per SCREENSHOTS.md's documented exception for non-visual, project-planning lessons, 0 screenshots is correct; slides use original 'steps' cards plus one 'code' card for the repo folder layout (not a claimed screenshot), matching the pattern from the Blockchain Engineering Capstones course's equivalent kickoff lesson.
